title: Complete organised guide and indexed folder loading
notes: Applies the complete Version 4 organisation to all 25,398 current streams across 142 ordered virtual folders, with Lebanon & Arabic and Australia & English first. Folder changes now query only their exact channel URLs in safe database batches instead of loading and filtering the entire catalogue, reducing remote lag, ANRs and memory-pressure crashes. Notification permission handling and add-on URL encoding are hardened, the full release lint and unit-test gates pass, and 377,216 real programme entries cover 8,598 guide channels. Existing favourites, custom folder choices, hidden channels, history, settings, add-ons and logins are preserved.
